front.title: PSI-07: Receipts for Organic Production Records

abstract.t:
This document defines PSI-07, a domain profile of Proof of Stateful Integrity (PSI) for production records for organic certification, such as input purchases, field activities, and inspection notes. Each record is sealed as a PSI receipt so that later alteration, reordering, or removal is detectable. Only digests are sealed. PSI-07 shows integrity and ordering only; it does not show that a product is organic or that any certification standard was met.
Earlier revisions carried this title over an abstract describing regulatory monitoring signals. This revision makes the body match the title.
